_about: Weekly menu from the Toddler Weekly Menu. days[0] is Sunday. 'tonight' is the before-bed thaw task for the next day's food. leadMinutes = how long before the ready time to start cooking.

breakfast.name: Egg bites, toast and mango
steps: Microwave 3 egg bites 20–30 seconds until warm.
Serve with 25 g soft whole-grain toast and 45 g ripe mango, finely chopped.

dinner.name: Chicken and soba with tahini sauce
steps: Warm the shredded chicken, covered, with a splash of water until steaming, then cool to warm.
Cook soba per the package, rinse, and cut into short pieces. (Cooked soba turns gummy in the freezer.)
Microwave frozen edamame with a splash of water, 3 min, and mash. Reheat the carrots and peppers.
Make sesame-ginger sauce: whisk 3 Tbsp tahini, 3 Tbsp warm water, 1 tsp grated fresh ginger, 1 small grated garlic clove and the juice of ½ lemon until smooth.
Serve with: Thinly sliced scallions and peeled cucumber matchsticks for everyone.
dinner.plate: 30 g chicken, 35 g edamame, 50 g soba, 40 g carrots, 30 g pepper, 8 g sauce.
dinner.why: Boiling the water and cooking the soba takes about 15 minutes.

breakfast.name: Egg, avocado toast and orange
steps: Peel a hard-boiled egg from prep day and cut into quarters or small pieces.
Lightly toast 25 g whole-grain bread so it stays soft. Spread with 30 g mashed avocado plus a squeeze of lemon (slows browning) and cut into strips.
Cut the peel and white pith off an orange, slice the segments out from between the membranes, remove seeds and cut small. Pack in a small container.

dinner.name: Beef, lentil and barley stew
steps: Reheat the stew until steaming, then let Rafa's portion cool to warm.
Serve with: Chopped parsley and a little grated parmesan on every bowl, with crusty bread on the side (soft inside pieces for Rafa).
dinner.plate: Shred 30 g beef finely, lightly mash 45 g lentils, add 45 g barley and 30 g soft pepper, stir in 1 tsp olive oil.

breakfast.name: Yogurt bowl
steps: Stir 20 g infant oat cereal into 100 g plain whole-milk yogurt; add a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Top with 40 g finely chopped strawberries, 7 g ground walnuts and 1 tsp hemp hearts.
Thin 1 tsp peanut butter with 1 tsp warm water and swirl it in.

dinner.name: Baked salmon, sweet potato, broccoli and quinoa
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix 2 Tbsp olive oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, the zest of ½ lemon and 1 Tbsp chopped fresh parsley. Spread over a 1½–2 lb salmon fillet and bake 12–15 min, until it flakes and reads 145°F inside.
Flake the salmon with your fingers to find and remove every bone.
Reheat the broccoli, sweet potato and quinoa. Mash the sweet potato with a splash of milk.
Serve with: Lemon wedges for the salmon and a sprinkle of parmesan on the broccoli.
dinner.plate: 28 g salmon, 65 g sweet potato, 35 g broccoli, 45 g quinoa, 1 tsp olive oil.
dinner.why: The oven needs to heat, then the salmon bakes 12–15 minutes.

days.tonight: Move 3 muffins from the freezer to the fridge for tomorrow's hike.

breakfast.name: Pumpkin blueberry oat muffins with kiwi
steps: Pack 3 mini muffins.
Peel 1 kiwi, cut into thin strips and pack in a small container.

dinner.name: Leftover salmon, mashed potato, peas and carrots
steps: Flake Tuesday's salmon and check again for bones. Warm it covered in the microwave at half power, 30–60 seconds, or serve it cold.
Reheat the mashed potato and carrots until steaming.
Microwave frozen peas with a splash of water, 2–3 min, and mash with a fork.
Stir together lemon-chive yogurt sauce: 3 Tbsp plain whole-milk yogurt, 1 tsp chopped chives and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve with: A drizzle of olive oil over the salmon.
dinner.plate: 28 g salmon, 60 g potato, 35 g peas, 40 g carrots, a spoonful of yogurt sauce.
dinner.why: Everything is reheated; the peas take about 3 minutes.

days.tonight: Move the pasta sauce and 3 egg bites from the freezer to the fridge.

breakfast.name: Spinach-mushroom egg bites, oatmeal and kiwi
steps: Microwave 3 egg bites 20–30 seconds until warm.
Stir 20 g (about ⅓ cup) infant oatmeal into 60–80 ml warm water until smooth.
Peel the kiwi and cut into thin strips.

dinner.name: Beef and white bean pasta
steps: Cook 8 oz small whole-wheat pasta 1–2 min longer than the package says so it's soft.
Reheat the sauce until steaming.
Serve with: Grated parmesan for everyone, and torn fresh basil if you have it.
dinner.plate: 50 g pasta with 30 g beef, 45 g lightly mashed beans and 40 g sauce mixed through.

days.tonight: Move one portion of braised chicken, the farro, the frozen peppers and 4 pancakes from the freezer to the fridge.

breakfast.name: Ricotta mini pancakes with raspberries
steps: Pack 3–4 pancakes. They're good cold, or toast them briefly and let them cool before packing.
Halve 40 g raspberries and pack in a small container.

dinner.name: Braised chicken with chickpeas, kale and farro
steps: Reheat the chicken, farro and peppers until steaming.
Squeeze fresh lemon over Rafa's portion. Freezing cuts vitamin C, and the fresh lemon restores the boost that helps Rafa absorb iron from the chickpeas.
Serve with: Crumbled feta (a small sprinkle on Rafa's) and extra lemon.
dinner.plate: Shred 30 g chicken finely, mash 45 g chickpeas, add 25 g kale, 30 g pepper, 50 g farro and 1 tsp olive oil.
dinner.why: The chicken and farro just need reheating.

days.tonight: Move the squash, quinoa, turkey-bean mix and Sunday's shredded chicken from the freezer to the fridge.

breakfast.name: Peanut butter quinoa porridge with egg
steps: Warm 65 g cooked quinoa with 60 ml whole milk, 3–4 min, until creamy.
Thin 8 g (about 1½ tsp) smooth peanut butter with a little warm water and stir it in with 1 tsp hemp hearts.
Top with 45 g ripe pear, finely chopped. Serve a hard-boiled egg, chopped small.

dinner.name: Turkey and black bean bowl
steps: Reheat the turkey-bean mix and squash until steaming. Warm the peppers.
Mash ¼ avocado with a squeeze of lime.
Serve with: Warm soft tortillas, shredded cheese, chopped cilantro and lime wedges. Tear a tortilla into strips for Rafa.
dinner.plate: 30 g turkey, 45 g beans, 50 g squash, 30 g avocado, 25 g pepper.

days.tonight: Move 3 egg bites and the frozen carrots from the freezer to the fridge.
